message.content:
The founder of Buddhism is **Siddhartha Gautama**, who is commonly known as the **Buddha**.  
He lived in the 5th–4th centuries BCE in the region that is now part of **modern-day Nepal and northern India**. The earliest Buddhist teachings emerged around the area of **Lumbini** (birthplace) and later crystallized in **Bodh Gaya** (the place of his enlightenment).
